title: Immunohistochemical Staining of Heparan Sulfate and Collagen Type XVIII in Human Islets
author: Lora Starrs

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Immerse each slide in xylene for 1 min, then rehydrate through graded alcohols: dip 10 times in absolute ethanol, 10 times in 90 % ethanol, and 10 times in 70 % ethanol. Wash slides in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Encircle Sections and Rinse
steps.instruction: Wipe around each tissue section with a clean tissue, draw a circle around the section with a diamond pencil, and place the slide in a container holding 250 ml of tap water.

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 3 % hydrogen peroxide in methanol (prepare by mixing 25 ml 30 % H₂O₂ with 225 ml methanol) for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash After Peroxidase Block
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice for 2 min each in 250 ml phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS), then rinse in running tap water for 5 min.

steps.title: Prewarm Humidified Tray
steps.instruction: Place a slide tray containing a low level of water in a 37 °C incubator to humidify.

steps.title: Prepare Pronase Solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.5 mg pronase (Calbiochem #537088) in 5 ml deionized water to obtain a 0.5 mg ml⁻¹ (0.05 %) solution.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval with Pronase
steps.instruction: Cover each section with the pronase solution, wipe around the sections with tissue, and incubate in the humidified tray at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Wash After Pronase
steps.instruction: Wash slides twice for 2 min each in 250 ml PBS.

steps.title: Block Non‑Specific Ig Binding
steps.instruction: For HS staining, apply animal‑free blocking solution diluted to 20 % v/v with deionized water; for Col‑18 staining, apply diluted protein concentrate. Incubate 5 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue before adding block.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: For HS: add 0.2 mg ml⁻¹ anti‑HS monoclonal antibody (or 0.2 mg ml⁻¹ mouse IgM isotype control) diluted in protein‑concentrate solution, 125–150 µl per section, and incubate 1 h at room temperature. For Col‑18: add 2 µg ml⁻¹ anti‑Col‑18 monoclonal antibody (or 2 µg ml⁻¹ mouse IgG₂bκ isotype control) diluted similarly, 125–150 µl per section, and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue before adding antibody.

steps.title: Wash After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with PBS, transfer to a container with 250 ml PBS, and wash twice for 2 min each.

steps.title: Apply Secondary HRP Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with secondary HRP‑rabbit anti‑mouse Ig at 26 µg ml⁻¹ (or 3.2 µg ml⁻¹ for HS IgM or 3.2 µg ml⁻¹ for Col‑18 IgG), 130–150 µl per section, for 30 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue before adding secondary antibody.

steps.title: Wash After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with PBS, transfer to a container with 250 ml PBS, and wash twice for 2 min each.

steps.title: Prepare AEC Substrate
steps.instruction: Mix 4.75 ml acetate buffer, 0.25 ml AEC stock solution, and 25 µl 3 % H₂O₂; filter through a disposable 0.2 µm filter. Use within 2 h, keep refrigerated, and protect from light.

steps.title: Develop Color with AEC
steps.instruction: Cover sections with the AEC working solution, wipe around sections with tissue, and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash After AEC Development
steps.instruction: Rinse slides with deionized water, transfer to a container with 250 ml deionized water, and wash three times (total ~10 min).

steps.title: Counterstain, Wash, and Mount
steps.instruction: Lightly counterstain sections with Gill’s hematoxylin, wash in deionized water twice, dip briefly (2 × 2 sec) in ammonium water (100 µl ammonia in 250 ml deionized water), wash deionized water twice (250 ml each), and coverslip using Glycergel mounting medium.

substeps.instruction: Wipe around sections with tissue before each reagent addition.

steps.title: Image and Quantify Staining
steps.instruction: Capture images with a light microscope equipped with a camera, then analyze % of islet area stained using ImageJ’s color deconvolution plugin.
